outcome: Performance Management now uses one visual system for its existing employee, manager and HR workflows. The delivery changes presentation and navigation accessibility while preserving product permissions and data contracts.
delivered: One shared palette feeds server-rendered CSS, Tailwind and Material UI. System typography replaces competing remote fonts.
Sign-in, dashboard, appraisals, reports and conversation surfaces use quieter layouts and solid semantic actions.
Keyboard navigation, mobile focus containment, resize recovery and accessibility preference fallbacks are implemented.
Twelve story packages, per-story architecture and UX handoffs, paired reviews and reusable role skills document the work.
